18 × 24 equals 432.

**How to find it**  
• Think of 20 houses on a street, each with 18 windows.  
• Multiply 20 × 18 = 360 (you can do 2 × 18 = 36, then add a zero).  
• Now we need the remaining 4 houses: 4 × 18 = 72.  
• Add the two parts: 360 + 72 = **432**.

**Everyday example**  
If a class has 18 students and the teacher gives each student 24 stickers, the class will have 432 stickers in all.
